findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Subscriptions.Rules.refundOnCancel matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: numeric literal 150 (line 18): value 150 equals no declared parameter of an accepted or superseded record; wildcard default returning 0m for unlisted cases (line 20): value 0 equals no declared parameter of an accepted or superseded record. A wildcard default silently decides every unlisted case; no record authorizes that default. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
